abstract: By the administration of carcinogens to the fetal membrane of pregnant rats, yolk sac tumors producing AFP was induced. The process of production of such tumors and AFP was studied at the ultrastructural level. Electron microscopy revealed that the structure of the tumor induced extended radiately around the tubal cavity, and the cubical cells were arranged in rows. Microvilli were observed on the cellular surface toward the tubal cavity. The adjacent cells were relatively diffused and an interdigitation was partly observed, but formation of incomplete desmosome was also apparence. The nuclei were generally large, some being irregular in shape. Nucleoli with a thread-like nucleolonema were also observed. There was rich organella in the cytoplasm and mitochondria and r-ER was particularly noted. In the r-ER the intracavity was enlarged containing some substances with moderate density. Some granules with the same density as said substance were present in the cytoplasm. This substance was recognized to be AFP. As the source of the material, rich free-ribosome and glycogen granules were observed around the r-ER with an amorphous substance. Due to the effect of functional collaboration, AFP was produced and accumulated in the r-ER according to the same process as protein synthesis.
abstract_ja: 妊娠ラットの胎児膜に発がん物質を投与することで、AFPを産生する卵黄嚢腫瘍が誘発された。その産生過程とAFPの生成について、超微細構造レベルで検討した。電子顕微鏡では、腫瘍は管腔の周囲に放射状に広がり、立方状の細胞が列をなして配列していた。管腔側の細胞表面には微絨毛が認められた。隣接する細胞は比較的まばらで、部分的に相互嵌入がみられたが、不完全な接着装置も認められた。核は一般に大きく、一部は不規則な形をしていた。細胞質には豊富なオルガネラがあり、ミトコンドリアと粗面小胞体(r-ER)が特に目立った。r-ERでは槽内が拡張し、中等度の濃度を持つ物質が含まれていた。同じ濃度の顆粒が細胞質内にも存在した。この物質はAFPであると認められた。物質の供給源としては、無定形物質とともにr-ERの周囲に豊富な遊離リボソームとグリコーゲン顆粒が認められた。機能的な協調作用により、AFPはタンパク質合成と同じ過程で産生され、r-ERに蓄積されると考えられた。
